about.title: About Me & Professional Background
bio: A Multimedia Communications student with a strong aesthetic sense and a solid foundation in visual production.
Looking forward to contributing creative ideas to support brands digital marketing campaigns and brand assets in a fast-paced, international environment.
about.philosophy: Visual design is the bridge between brand strategy, aesthetic discipline, and audience emotion.
about.approach: I approach every creative campaign with end-to-end discipline: from conceptual visual identity and key poster designs to high-engagement social media assets and calibrated video finishing.

highlights: Operated the official faculty fanpage; designed core media assets (posters, infographics, photo quotes) and covered on-site live event photography.
Maintained consistent visual branding and boosted student engagement across faculty media channels.
Led end-to-end media production (video, photo, graphics) and managed event execution teams.
Served on the Core Organizing Committee for Meet & Connect Hackathon DigiPort Logistics 2025 and Orientation Day 2026.
Successfully coordinated media and logistics for 3 flagship events, reaching hundreds of participants university-wide.
